November 11, 2026
Protecting our customers' data and accounts is a priority for United.
That's why we designed our industry-leading, award-winning United app to securely empower customers to manage their own travel experience - everything from booking a trip and choosing seats to rescheduling a flight when the weather is bad and so much more.
On the other hand, sharing account credentials with personal, third-party, Al assistants can expose sensitive information, and actions taken by these tools may result in unintended purchases, account changes, or use of MileagePlus miles. Plus, these automated Al actions have the potential to violate FAA and DOT regulations - as an example, flight check-in requires human acknowledgment that bags do not contain banned substances like explosives.
As a result, United is taking steps to restrict access - directly within our digital platforms and indirectly via travel agencies and aggregators - to prohibit use by unauthorized, third-party personal Al agents or assistants. This work includes updates to our booking, ticketing and distribution policies.
